web_evidence.title: Grind It Out Until You’re Dead: James Patterson and Michael Ledwidge’s Step on a Crack
web_evidence.note: Daniel R. Robichaud explicitly describes Bennett's first-person chapters alternating with limited third-person chapters about antagonists and hostages. Cited passages from pages 60–62 demonstrate sustained third-person Rooney narration; pages 336–337 show first-person Bennett narration surrounding Seamus's speech, resolving q01368 and q01371.

person_note: Michael Bennett narrates his chapters in first person, while autonomous third-person chapters follow antagonists and hostages. The authorized chapter excerpt and Goodreads speech beats establish Bennett's strand; the detailed review supplies explicit structural evidence and an interior third-person passage. Seamus's first-person remarks in q01368 and q01371 are dialogue, not another narrating strand. ALTERNATING is supported, with medium confidence because whole-book alternation and interior third-person coverage rely on one credible review rather than independently verified authorized interior excerpts.
